title: Story
description: Single input for media-builder. All narration text lives here verbatim; downstream steps may never invent facts. Runtime validation is done with zod (src/types.ts is the source of truth).

id.description: Lowercase slug; used for output paths (build/<id>/<id>.mp4).

sources.description: Where the facts come from. At least one required; rendered as attribution on the final shot.

hook.description: Opening line, spoken verbatim over the first shot.

beats.description: The story, one narration line per beat, in order.

id.description: Unique per story; 'hook' and 'outro' are reserved.

text.description: Narration, spoken verbatim. Must be supported by the listed sources.

visualHint.description: Optional scene description for image generation. Anything depictive is tagged 'reconstruction' downstream.

outro.description: Optional closing line, spoken verbatim over the final shot.
